# Scenario replays

Documented cases replayed through the rules. Where a defect was documented, the same sequence runs under an illustrative legacy control and under Solutio. Quantities are normalized unless the source gives figures.

## S01 · 62 bodies adhere to one record (TCU Acórdão 1.487/2007)

*Level:* Brazil (national) · *Evidence:* `BR-TCU-1487-2007`

**Question.** What would a record registered for 100 units deliver if 62 non-participants each asked for half?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| 62 requests of 50 units each (half the record) | ✅ 200 units granted, 58 requests refused by PROC-02 |

**Finding.** Without caps, TCU computed a theoretical exposure of 62x the tendered value (if every adherent bought the full quantity). With art. 86 enforced at request time, the 5th and later requests are refused: 200 units (2x) is the ceiling.

## S02 · 50% of an odd quantity (TCU 547/2026, para. 67)

*Level:* Brazil (national) · *Evidence:* `BR-TCU-547-2026`

**Question.** Does the control round the 50% cap up or down?

| Step | Legacy control | Solutio |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Adherent requests 11 of 21 registered units | ✅ cap 11: 11 accepted (52.4% > 50%) | ⛔ `PROC-01` cap 10: 11 refused |

**Finding.** Rounding up lets each adherent exceed the statutory 50%; TCU recommends rounding down (item 9.1.1.6), which Solutio does.

## S03 · Adhesion balance goes negative (TCU 547/2026, para. 66)

*Level:* Brazil (national) · *Evidence:* `BR-TCU-547-2026`

**Question.** Can concurrent pending requests push total adhesions above 2x?

| Step | Legacy control | Solutio |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Five bodies file 50 units each before any is authorized; all are then authorized | ✅ 250 authorized; balance -50 | ⛔ `PROC-02` 5th request refused at filing; balance 0 |

**Finding.** When pending requests do not reserve quantity, the balance goes negative exactly as TCU observed (-2, -155, -25 in real records). Reserving at request time makes a negative balance unreachable.

## S04 · Authorization after the record expired (TCU 547/2026, para. 68)

*Level:* Brazil (national) · *Evidence:* `BR-TCU-547-2026`

**Question.** Can a request filed while valid be authorized after expiry?

| Step | Legacy control | Solutio |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Request on day 0, authorization on day 20, record valid until day 10 | ✅ authorized 10; execute by day 1010 | ⛔ `PROC-05` record expired: authorization refused |

**Finding.** Solutio checks validity at authorization too (TCU item 9.1.1.7).

## S05 · A body needing 18 units reaches them across three identical items

*Level:* Field (founder's anonymized operational knowledge) · *Evidence:* `FIELD-STATE-CPB`

**Question.** Does the per-item cap hold, and what is the body's share of the object?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| Request 18 units on the item with 21 registered | ⛔ `PROC-01` exceeds 50% cap (10 units) |
| Request 4 of 10 registered | ✅ quantity reserved |
| Request 10 of 21 registered | ✅ quantity reserved |
| Request 4 of 8 registered | ✅ quantity reserved |

**Finding.** Each item stays within 50% ([40.0, 47.6, 50.0]%). Across the object the body holds 46.2% of 39 units, so the split also respects a per-object reading. Solutio reports this aggregate (PROC-15) without judging it.

## S06 · Participant supply authorizations and rectification

*Level:* Field (founder's anonymized operational knowledge) · *Evidence:* `FIELD-STATE-CPB`

**Question.** Can a body use a record where it is not a participant, and what happens when an authorization is rectified?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| Use 48 units of a record where it is a participant | ✅ supply authorized from own quota (0 left) |
| Use 1 more unit | ⛔ `PROC-11` exceeds own quota (0 left) |
| Use 8 units of a record where it is not a participant | ⛔ `PROC-11` state-university is not a participant of this record |
| Rectify the authorization from 48 to 36 after budget review | ✅ 12 restored to state-university's quota |

**Finding.** The record itself refuses a non-participant and restores rectified quantity, instead of a manual check in spreadsheets.

## S07 · Alagoas: state bodies and municipal records (Decree 95.019/2023, art. 33)

*Level:* State (Alagoas) · *Evidence:* `AL-DECREE-95019`

**Question.** Which municipal records may an Alagoas state body adhere to?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| Alagoas state body → non-capital municipal record | ⛔ `PROC-09` Alagoas state body cannot adhere to a non-capital municipal record |
| Alagoas state body → state-capital municipal record | ✅ quantity reserved |
| State body under the federal baseline → same non-capital record | ✅ quantity reserved |

**Finding.** The same request has different outcomes depending on the adherent's regulation: rules are profiles, not hard-coded law.

## S08 · EU framework agreement with a split maximum (CJEU C-23/20)

*Level:* European Union · *Evidence:* `EU-CJEU-C23-20`, `EU-CJEU-C216-17`

**Question.** Does the same engine enforce the EU rule that an agreement ends at its maximum?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| Unidentified authority calls off 10 | ⛔ `EU-02` authority-C is not identified in the notice |
| A calls off its 600 | ✅ call-off accepted (400 left) |
| A calls off 1 more | ⛔ `EU-03` exceeds authority-A's share (0 left) |
| B calls off its 400 | ✅ call-off accepted (0 left) |
| B calls off 1 more | ⛔ `EU-01` maximum reached: the agreement has no further effect |

**Finding.** Same failure mode, different law: identified buyers, a shared maximum and per-buyer shares.

## S09 · One receivable, several financiers (Qingdao, First Brands, Tricolor pattern)

*Level:* Global · *Evidence:* `GL-QINGDAO-2014`, `GL-FIRSTBRANDS-2025`, `GL-TRICOLOR-2025`

**Question.** Can the same government receivable or document be financed twice?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| Financier A advances R$ 6.000 | ✅ financed 600000; 400000 left |
| Financier B advances R$ 4.000 | ✅ financed 400000; 0 left |
| Financier C advances R$ 0,01 | ⛔ `PAY-04` would exceed eligible balance (0 left) |
| The same invoice is attached to a second receivable | ⛔ `PAY-04` document already backs receivable NE-001 |

**Finding.** Duplicate pledges become impossible inside the registry; financing outside it is not prevented (stated limitation).

## S10 · Chronological payment order (Lei 14.133, art. 141)

*Level:* Brazil (national) · *Evidence:* `BR-LAW-14133-ART141`

**Question.** Is an out-of-order payment visible and justified?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| Pay C-2 before C-1 without justification | ⛔ `PAY-02` C-1 is earlier in the Tesouro/goods queue |
| Pay C-2 before C-1 citing art. 141 §1, II | ✅ out of order, justified (SMALL_BUSINESS_AT_RISK); must be published |
| Pay C-1 | ✅ paid in order |

**Finding.** Deviation is allowed only with a listed justification, and the log is what must be published monthly (§3).

## S11 · When delay becomes a legal event

*Level:* Global · *Evidence:* `BR-LAW-14133-ART137`, `EU-DIR-2011-7`

**Question.** When does a late payment cross a statutory threshold?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| BR: invoice of 2026-07-01, checked on 2026-10-09 | ⛔ `PAY-03` PAY-03: 100 days overdue; supplier may suspend or terminate |
| EU: invoice of 2026-07-01, checked on 2026-10-09 | ⛔ `PAY-07` PAY-07: 100 days > 30-day limit |

**Finding.** Each obligation's age is public on-chain, so the moment it crosses a legal threshold is verifiable.

## S12 · AntecipaGov limits (IN SEGES/MGI 82/2025)

*Level:* Brazil (national) · *Evidence:* `BR-ANTECIPAGOV`

**Question.** Do the federal advance rules translate into a profile?

| Step | Solutio |
| --- | --- |
| Bank X advances 70.000 of 100.000 remaining | ✅ advance of 70000 with bank-X |
| Bank Y offers a follow-on | ⛔ `PAY-06` a follow-on operation must be with the same bank |
| Bank X advances 30.000 more | ⛔ `PAY-06` exceeds 70% of the remaining balance (21000) |
| Bank X advances 21.000 more | ✅ advance of 21000 with bank-X |

**Finding.** A federal programme's financing rules become one more profile over the same single-financing ledger.
